snippet.title: Don't Meet His Gaze: Gogalvi Boss Fight (Work in Progress) | Zukarii Pre-Alpha
snippet.description:
A first look at Gogalvi, a new boss for Zukarii, fought by a level 35 Battle Mage. This is a work-in-progress fight on Pre-Alpha v0.4.0: mechanics, tuning and art (including the gaze beam and effects) are all placeholder and will change.

Gogalvi is inspired by the Viy of Slavic folklore, whose stare finds anything that hides. Unlike some of the other bosses he brings no minions. It's just you, him, and a ring of stone pillars.

How the fight works
👁 Revealing Gaze: he tears his iron mask in two and sweeps a beam across the room. Stay in it too long and you're Marked: (big debuff)
🗿 Break line of sight: the pillars around the brazier are your cover. Outrun the sweep up close, or put stone between you and him.
🕳 Burrow & Erupt: he digs into the floor and hunts you from below; watch for his shadow. If you're Marked when he comes up, there's no outrunning it.
🦶 Up close, he rakes with his claws and kicks you back.

Zukarii is an isometric action RPG in development. Feedback on the fight is very welcome in the comments!
